richiami.difetto: For affected vehicles with a rear seat equipped with an ISOFIX attachment system the welded joints of the ISOFIX attachment points may have been manufactured with a defect and could fail in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Users are asked to stop using ISOFIX connection points to attach child seats with immediate effect. Dealers or garages will inspect and if necessary replace the ISOFIX bracket.
richiami.titolo: ISOFIX connection system for rear seats of motorhomes and camper vans

richiami.difetto: The tyre valves may fail as they are rated to 70psi and the maximum operating pressure for the tyre is 80psi. Note: the recommended operating pressures for the tyres when fitted to the vehicles in question are between 50 and 70psi. It is only when the tyre pressure is over 70psi that a failure might occur.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the rubber valves with higher rated metal bolt in valves.

richiami.difetto: The GRP body specifically the wheelarch has been manufactured to an incorrect profile and can under certain circumstances come into contact with the tyre and may puncture it.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check or trim wheelarch to create a 25 mm tolerance between tyre and body
richiami.titolo: TYRE MAY PUNCTURE BY CONTACTING WHEEL ARCH

richiami.difetto: It has been identified thatcertain versions of the FASP seat may inadvertently de-latch which in the worst case could lead to loss of vehicle control and cause the seat belt to become ineffective in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject seat checked and modified as necessary.

richiami.difetto: Bolts of the wrong specification have been fitted to the forward facing bed box. In extreme circumstances it is possible that the seat belt mounting could detach from the chassis.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to fit bolts of the correct specification to the forward facing bed box.

richiami.difetto: Incorrect specification wheel bolts fitted to alloy wheels. Wheel nut may loosen in service.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the wheel bolts with ones that are the correct specification.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the refrigerator flue may not have been connected such that fumes may enter the habitation area.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the refrigerator flue extension fitted correctly.
richiami.titolo: REFRIGERATOR EXHAUST FUMES MAY ENTER THE HABITATION AREA.

richiami.difetto: In extreme circumstances the seat latching system may fail to hold the seat in it correct location.  If this occurs the passenger make contact the dashboard or result in the driver loosing control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to have additional brackets fitted to the front seats and replace the travel end stops.

richiami.difetto: Engine exhaust fumes may travel up the 'B' post and enter the cab area.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new designed exhaust extension
richiami.titolo: EXHAUST FUMES COULD ENTER THE CAB AREA

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that two bolts are missing from the installation of the forward facing bed box which in extreme circumstances could result in the seat belt mounting detaching from the chassis.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject mountings fitted with replacement high tensile bolts

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that during production a spacer has been omitted from the nearside forward facing bed box seatbelt. This over time may cause the seatbelt to wear against the mounting bracket.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a replacement seatbelt and spacer.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the 20mm 10.9 tensile strength allen key head bolts with 20mm 12.9 tensile strength Unbrako bolts.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the wiring behind the cooker with the wiring instructions. Where neccessary refit the earth wire in the correct position.
